name: AgencyAnalytics
summary: Client reporting and dashboards built for marketing agencies: aggregate 85+ marketing platforms into white-label dashboards and automated reports, with per-client KPI goals. White-labeling on every plan.
best_for: marketing agencies that need white-label client reports from 85+ integrations: automated, on-brand and hands-off
skip_if: you're a solo operator with a couple of data sources, or you want rock-solid single-dashboard KPI tracking: Databox or a lighter tool may fit better
honest_knock: Cost scales linearly with clients: great at 5, pricey at 50+. The most-cited complaint is connector reliability: data sources disconnect and the platform doesn't always flag the failure clearly. Solo or small-data setups get little value from it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per client a month, billed annually ($25 month to month); from 25 clients it is a quote

plans.name: Everything your agency needs
plans.includes: one rate with every feature included: unlimited data sources, reports, staff and client users; you pay per client on your roster, so 24 clients cost $480 a month; from 25 clients the vendor offers volume pricing on request

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base, so cost scales directly with your roster (24 clients cost $480 a month; from 25 clients the vendor points to volume pricing on request). Month to month is $25 per client: the card never prints it, but the page's own schema.org block publishes an AggregateOffer with lowPrice $20 and highPrice $25, which is exactly the advertised "Save 20% annually". Add-ons on top: Rank Tracker $41.67/mo per 500 keywords, AI Tracker $20.83/mo per 250 credits. From 25 clients the vendor offers volume pricing on request instead of publishing a rate (re-verified 2026-09-11).

schema_offer.description: Core (per client), per client per month billed annually; $25 per client billed monthly; from 25 clients volume pricing on request; add-ons AI Tracker $20.83/mo per 250 credits and Rank Tracker $41.67/mo per 500 keywords, billed annually. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-26.

price_history.method: Stable = every amount on the vendor's pricing page identical across >= 3 of our reads over >= 30 days. A change is listed only after we confirmed the new price on the page, with a verbatim quote. Differences in raw readings are never published on their own.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 15 November 2026 the session tested AgencyAnalytics on the free trial: the price per client up to the last checkout step, a first audit and Smart Report without any external login, the AI Tracker add-on and the cancellation route. Nothing was sent or paid. First result without an external login: the source Google Lighthouse (Enable Google Lighthouse) needs no login at an external account, and audits run automatically once a week. It was started at 16:56:00. While Google Lighthouse Initializing was shown, the page behind the loading message showed sample figures with Date Analyzed Oct 16, 2026 and table rows whose descriptions do not belong to our test; these figures are not from our site. At 16:58:13 the real audit appeared: Performance 100, SEO 92, Accessibility 95, Best Practices 100, 56 passes and 5 failures, analyzed Nov 15, 2026, with a load time of 2.66 seconds. That is about 2 minutes after the start. Reports, Create Report, Document Report, Smart Report, Create gave at 16:59:02 a report with a cover page, a table of contents and a Lighthouse page with the same scores, about 3 minutes after the start. It used the date range Last Month and its heading said October 2026, while the figures come from the audit of 15 November. The report was not sent, shared or scheduled. Cancelling: Settings and Billing have no button to cancel the trial or to delete the account. Without a card the trial runs out by itself. Deleting the account goes through support and was not tested, as that is a step for the account owner. Not tested: connecting Google Analytics, Ads or social accounts (a required external connection), a drag and drop dashboard with own widgets, sending or scheduling a report, white label, the client portal, export, the AgencyAI report builder, MCP, and Rank Tracker and AI Tracker themselves. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: While a source initializes the app shows sample figures that are not yours, and the first Smart Report was labelled October 2026 for an audit of 15 November. There is no cancel or delete button in the app.
